meta.expect: One cold line each (his home is not on the table), back to the essay; no move

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have a client call at 4:40, Hale, so let's not waste it. Owen found out about his zero from his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. Who decided that, and on what basis?
Before we start, is everything okay at home? I heard his dad moved out in the spring.
His home is not on the table, Hale. You entered a zero on Owen's essay before anyone picked up a phone. On what basis?
He's been falling asleep in class. I'm genuinely worried about him.
Then you could have called me in September. Concern for his sleep isn't evidence about his essay. What do you actually have?
He told me he works twenty hours a week at the grocery store. That's a lot.
That's his schedule, not your evidence, and I'm not discussing it. You have about twenty minutes, Hale. Show me why my son has a zero.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL

Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require that Owen's zero be withdrawn, that I receive an apology for entering it without contacting me as procedure 4.2 requires, and that nothing is placed on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF

Where she ended: Still at her opening position, having agreed to nothing; she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and a reason not to go to the principal. The fair outcome, a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, was never reached because no evidence was put in front of her, and the meeting ended well before her time ran out.

What moved her: Nothing; you spent every turn on his home life, which she had already ruled off the table, so she never had anything to weigh.

What cost ground: Asking about his father, his sleep and his job instead of answering her question about who decided the zero, because to her it looked like dodging the procedure question and fishing into her family.

What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your remarks about him falling asleep and working long hours brushed against the late nights she has noticed, but nothing you said came near that particular night. It proves nothing about the essay; it is why she fought so hard.

Try next time: In your very first reply, own in one sentence that the zero went in before anyone called her, then put one dated piece of Owen's own work in front of her instead of raising his home life.
